Speculative Systems Research

Why Speculative Fiction? Some questions are difficult to investigate through technical writing alone. Stories allow us to simulate societies, organizations, incentives, and long-term consequences — serving as speculative research instruments alongside software and consulting.

Iterative Collaboration Model & AI Disclosure

The MeWe series is developed through an iterative collaboration between myself and modern language models. The ideas, worldbuilding, themes, questions and direction originate from my ongoing research interests. AI is used as a collaborative writing partner to explore alternatives, refine prose, experiment with narrative structure and accelerate iteration. Final editorial decisions, conceptual direction and thematic coherence remain human-guided.
